Genres filter

Motion·by @proskuaaa·2026-08-30·inspora page·original post

What it is

iOS dark filters sheet where the Genres row expands in place into a rotary wheel: genre names arranged along a curved arc that spin under the finger, checked genres get blue dots, and the footer button live-updates 'Continue with N'; the wheel collapses back into the row.

Genres row expands vertically in place (height animates, siblings push down) revealing a wheel: genre labels laid on an arc, rotated tangentially, fading toward edges.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: an iOS dark filters sheet where the Genres row expands in place into a rotary wheel - genre names laid along a curved arc spin under the finger with inertia, tapped genres get blue check dots, and the footer button live-updates "Continue with N". The wheel collapses back into the row.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve, canvas/shader notes are perf guidance only; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark filters sheet: rows for Location, Dates, Friends attend, Genres (summary "Afrobeat, Bluegrass +6"), Time, Price. Footer: Reset all + primary Continue button. Expanded Genres row: a wheel window where genre labels (Afrobeat, Bluegrass, Chant, EDM, Disco, Electronic, Experimental, Folk, Funk, Hip-Hop, House...) lie on an arc, rotated tangentially.

## Motion spec
Pattern: expanding row + gesture-driven rotary wheel.
- Expand: Genres row height animates open (350ms spring, siblings push down); wheel labels fade/scale in.
- Spin: labels rotate through the center window under the finger, 1:1 with drag; flick coasts with friction deceleration (cubic decel curve).
- Depth cue: center-most label crispest and full opacity; labels dim and rotate away toward the edges.
- Toggle: tap a label -> blue check dot pops in (scale 0 -> 1, 150ms); the row's summary text updates live.
- Collapse: height animates back, wheel crossfades to the summary text; footer CTA reads "Continue with 4".

## Calibration
- Expand 350ms with a soft spring - the sheet stretches, it does not pop.
- Wheel inertia needs real friction: a flick should coast 1-2s and settle, not stop dead or spin forever.
- Opacity/rotation falloff by angular distance is what sells the cylinder; linear falloff looks flat.

## Reduced motion
Wheel still spins 1:1 with drag (positional), but no inertia coast; expand/collapse are 200ms opacity+height tweens.

## Don't miss
- The row expands in place - the sheet does not navigate to a new screen.
- The summary text and the CTA count update live as dots toggle; no "apply" step.
- Labels rotate tangentially on the arc, not just translate horizontally.
